newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit stalls on short-cover, commercial demand.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit stalls on short-cover, commercial demand.

text.p: The ringgit stalled as dollar short-covering and commercial demand for dollar kept it on a weak trading range most of the day, dealers said.
Positive ringgit sentiment at the open due to positive economic data released at the weekend was quickly discounted.

"The market is apparently very long on the ringgit against the U.S. dollar. As such, players were merely taking this ringgit upsurge as a profit-taking opportunity," said research house I.D.E.A in its market commentary.
Malaysian importers took a cue from the ringgit's rise from late-Friday to buy dollars, dealers said.
